name: VESTFJORDEN APPROACHES
description: An older Project 877 Kilo threatens the waters northwest of Lofoten. The destroyer carries two MH-60Rs; a Norwegian P-8 detachment operates from Evenes with an attached US Triton. Two opposing strike aircraft are already airborne. The submarine is the mission target; the aircraft are supporting opposition. Real geography and real platform families; the conflict, the deployment and the tactical situation are fiction.

objectives.text: Neutralize the submarine threatening the approaches. Surviving aircraft do not prevent completion.
